example_sentences_in_bangla: সে বকবৃত্তি করে সকলকে প্রতারিত করছে।
তার বকবৃত্তি দেখে কেউ বিশ্বাস করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is practicing hypocritical piety to deceive everyone.
No one believes his hypocritical piety anymore.
history: The idiom originates from the observation of frogs croaking incessantly, which is likened to insincere or hypocritical religious chanting in Bengali folklore.
note: Refers to feigned religious devotion for personal gain.
